tasks.label: 开发：检查本地配置
tasks.command: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath '.env')) { throw '未找到根目录 .env。请先复制 .env.example 为 .env 并填写本地配置。' }

tasks.label: 开发：启动后端
tasks.command: $javaVersion = (& java -version 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 1); if ($javaVersion -notmatch 'version .21[.]') { $jdk21 = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.jdks') -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '21' -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $_.FullName 'bin\java.exe')) } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($jdk21) { $env:JAVA_HOME = $jdk21.FullName; $env:Path = (Join-Path $env:JAVA_HOME 'bin') + ';' + $env:Path } }; $javaVersion = (& java -version 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 1); if ($javaVersion -notmatch 'version .21[.]') { throw '后端需要 Java 21。请安装 Java 21 或在 VS Code 启动前设置 JAVA_HOME。' }; Get-Content -LiteralPath '${workspaceFolder}\.env' | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^([^#][^=]*)=(.*)$') { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($matches[1].Trim(), $matches[2].Trim(), 'Process') } }; .\mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run

tasks.label: 开发：启动管理端
tasks.command: $backendReady = $false; $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(120); while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) { try { $health = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:8080/api/v1/health' -TimeoutSec 2; if ($health.data.status -eq 'UP') { $backendReady = $true; break } } catch {}; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }; if (-not $backendReady) { throw '后端在 120 秒内未就绪，请查看“开发：启动后端”终端中的错误。' }; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath 'node_modules')) { npm ci; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } }; npm run dev
